name: forgejo-stack
description: Forgejo (T-1821) runs on vm700 as separate infrastructure owned by ansible (roles/ops-settings/tasks/forgejo.yaml), pinned by digest, published over HTTPS through the Caddy edge at the forge hostname, git over SSH on its own port, registration closed.

implementation.changes: New forgejo_stack tag gated on forgejo_enabled; image pinned by digest (15.0.9 LTS); sqlite3; INSTALL_LOCK + DISABLE_REGISTRATION + REQUIRE_SIGNIN_VIEW; mem_limit; health gate on /api/healthz and version assert on /api/v1/version; Caddy internal host block for the forge hostname; rollback documented.

checks: ansible-playbook ... --tags forgejo_stack -e forgejo_enabled=true completes with the version assert passing
curl https://<forge host>/api/healthz returns 200 with a valid Let's Encrypt certificate (curl without -k)
ssh -p 2222 to the forge host answers with an SSH banner
registration is closed: GET /user/sign_up does not offer a sign-up form
validation.result: 2026-09-22 live: play ok=10 failed=0, version assert passed (forgejo 15.0.9+gitea-1.22.0); https://forgejo.koeff.com/api/healthz 200 ssl_verify=0, cert CN=forgejo.koeff.com issuer Let's Encrypt notAfter 2026-12-21; /user/sign_up says Registration is disabled; ssh -p 2222 connects.
